stem_book: A block B is placed on block A. The mass of block B is less than the mass of block A. Friction exists between the blocks, whereas the ground on which the block A is placed is taken to be smooth. A horizontal force F, increasing linearly with time, begins to act on B. The accelerations a_A and a_B of blocks A and B respectively are plotted against t. The correctly plotted graph is (a)–(d): the four a–t graphs shown in the figure
key: D a_A becomes constant (horizontal); a_B rises more steeply
correct_answer: D a_A becomes constant (horizontal); a_B rises more steeply
reason: Options are drawings — figure bbox includes all four graphs; manifest paraphrased them.
work: Together a = F/(m_A+m_B); after slip a_A = μm_Bg/m_A (constant), a_B = (F − μm_Bg)/m_B with slope 1/m_B > 1/(m_A+m_B) → graph D
